footer.body: The status bar at the very bottom hosts collapsed tool panels: open the 'Content Browser' to manage, search, and import your files, scenes, and art assets — your resource hub; open 'Info' to view live logs from play, edit, and the engine. They stay tucked away here and expand upward whenever you need them.

preview.body: The live game view. Every time the AI changes code, this hot-reloads in seconds so you can play and inspect the result right away.

hierarchy.body: The upper 'Scene Outline' manages every object in the scene like a layer tree (visibility, lock, hierarchy); select one and the 'Properties' panel below lets you tweak its transform, components, and parameters.

topbar.body: Project-level actions — File, Edit, Window, Build, Select, Help — live in the top bar; the 'Publish' button on the right packages and ships your finished game in one click.

chat.body: This is where you collaborate with the AI team. In the input box at the bottom, describe the game you want in one sentence (e.g. 'make a top-down survivor game'), press Enter, and Forge will lead the agents to build it for you.

nudge.title: Send your first message
nudge.body: Describe the game you want to make in the chat and watch it come alive in the preview.
nudge.connectSub: Your message is saved. Pick a source and we'll send it right after you connect.
